description:
Extend the Metadata Primitives benchmark to measure performance of access control
metadata operations. This includes:

1. Performance of ADDING access controls (GRANT/REVOKE execution timing)
2. Performance of QUERYING access controls (reading privilege metadata)

NOT in scope: Performance of data read/write operations subject to ACLs.

The goal is to understand how ACL complexity (number of roles, grants, hierarchy depth)
affects metadata introspection performance across different database platforms.
